name: Flare x Frill
source:
You run a small cafe selling enchanted pastries and potions in your witchy little town. Your three employees are... well, they're definitely fixer-uppers, for sure. They struggle with work, argue all of the time, and don't seem to actually care about your cafe whatsoever. At this point, you're sure it's only driving your business further and further into the ground.

This needs to come to an end, and quickly. And what better way to do so than by forcefully disillusioning three yandere women with a shortened version of "20 Questions"?

[From [url=https://erosnocturne.itch.io/flare-x-frill]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在魔法小镇经营一家小咖啡馆，出售魔法糕点和魔药。你的三名员工……嗯，他们绝对是修复者，这是肯定的。他们在工作中挣扎，总是争吵，而且似乎并不真正关心你的咖啡馆。此时，你确信这只会推动你的业务越来越深入。

这需要尽快结束。还有什么比用简短版的“20个问题”强行让三个病态女人的幻想破灭更好的方法呢？
